title: Blood pressure effector gene predictions (Kamali et al., 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Large-Scale Multi-Omics Studies Provide New Insights into Blood Pressure Regulation.
Kamali Z, et al.
Int J Mol Sci. 2022 Jul 8;23(14):7557. doi: 10.3390/ijms23147557.
PMID: 35886906

The list below displays candidate causal genes for blood pressure. Genes were prioritized at blood pressure-associated loci by combining several types of evidence:

  • Presence of a coding variant genetically associated with blood pressure in the gene
  • Association of variants in the locus with DNA methylation, gene transcription, protein levels, and metabolite levels
  • Association of expression level with blood pressure
  • Coregulation with other genes in blood pressure-associated loci

Click the Research Method tab for more details about the analysis.
